note: One ring cell running along X. highway-kit is generated by tools/assets/highway_kit.py and authored in STUDS, so scale is 1.0 and every pos is studs. Origin = bottom centre of the cell at ground level; road surface 7.07 (= CityDressing highway.deckHeight), soffit 6.10 (contract floor 6.0), parapet top 7.87. The deck is 7.14 wide: it cantilevers 0.07 past the cell on its free edges - testfit reports that as exceeding the 7x7 footprint, it is the fascia overhang and is deliberate - and stops at exactly 3.5 on any edge that butts a neighbouring cell. One central pier per cell (2.6 x 4.8 studs at its widest, inside the deck band), so a run reads as a colonnade instead of the four corner legs the kit version stood on.
